analysisSummary: The query produces the terms latest, changes, and about, while ordinary commit messages need not contain any of them. The route supplies commits newest-first, but answer_question discards that ordering and refuses when literal overlap is zero. No fallback intent handling or other mitigation exists.
counterEvidence: None; engine.py:79-89 confirms overlap is the only selection path, and intelligence.py:238-255 confirms recent commits are available to it.
